goal: Remove the native header panel from the terminal window and change KitCode's primary color from matcha green to #fc0a0a across the dashboard, mini window, and terminal.

in: Make the terminal Electron BrowserWindow frameless like the mini window so it does not show the native macOS/Windows/Linux title/header panel.
Add or adapt terminal in-content chrome so the frameless window remains draggable and has a clear close control.

Preserve the terminal's current working behavior: centered launch, resizable window, sensible minimum dimensions, sandboxing, safe external-open behavior, command input, command history, output scrolling, and safe KitCode-only commands.
Change the dashboard primary brand/accent color from matcha green to `#fc0a0a` by updating the shared dashboard color token and direct primary-color literals.
Change the mini window primary/accent color from matcha green to `#fc0a0a`, including primary borders, glows, status accents, and progress styling.
Change the terminal primary/accent color from matcha green to `#fc0a0a`, including title/chrome accents, mode/status accents, prompt/caret, success copy, and primary glow treatments.
Update web metadata and SVG brand assets that explicitly use the old matcha primary color where they represent the dashboard brand surface.
Keep non-primary semantic states distinct, including ready/gold, offline/gray, error/red shades, and reward-specific accents where they communicate status rather than the global primary brand.
out: No changes to mini window size, placement, drag behavior, close behavior, or live update logic.
No stale-tracker detection, route readiness checks, tracker restart guidance, or health/version source-of-truth work in this requirement.
No changes to local API routes, tracker runtime, reward calculation, tier thresholds, redemption logic, equals counting, local state, or persistence.
No redesign of dashboard layout, setup gateway flow, admin content, registration flow, reward copy, or terminal command behavior.
No passthrough to the user's real shell, filesystem commands, `child_process` execution from terminal input, or arbitrary command execution.

acceptance_criteria.summary: `kitcode terminal` uses a frameless Electron BrowserWindow like `kitcode mini`; the native OS title/header panel is not visible.
The terminal HTML provides an in-content draggable chrome area and close control while command input, output scroll, links, and interactive controls remain no-drag.
The terminal remains centered, resizable, sandboxed, and safe-shell-only, with help/status/summary/rewards/dashboard/mini/clear behavior unchanged.

The React dashboard's global primary token and direct primary green literals are changed to `#fc0a0a` or equivalent rgba values, so text, borders, buttons, selection, progress, glows, and brand SVG/meta surfaces no longer use matcha green as the primary.
`/mini` uses `#fc0a0a` as the default primary accent instead of matcha green, while ready and offline state colors remain semantically distinct.
`/terminal` uses `#fc0a0a` as the default primary accent instead of matcha green across chrome, prompt, caret, success, and primary highlight styling.
Implementation does not change CLI command behavior, local API response shapes, tracker runtime, reward contracts, or persistence.
Dashboard, mini, and terminal remain readable after the red primary swap; text does not overlap or clip, and primary text/background combinations keep practical contrast.

coverage_plan.summary: Run the CLI package build script after implementation so existing command, mini, terminal, reward, snapshot, ledger, and syntax checks still pass.
Run the web build after the color swap so Tailwind classes, CSS tokens, metadata, and React dashboard code compile.
Update terminal window checks to assert `frame: false`, preserved `resizable: true`, custom drag/no-drag regions, close control, sandboxing, safe external opening, and red primary variables.
Update mini window checks to assert the selected panel layout still works and the default primary accent is `#fc0a0a` rather than matcha green.

Run `kitcode dashboard`, `kitcode mini`, and `kitcode terminal`, then verify the dashboard, mini, and terminal all use red primary styling, the terminal has no native header panel, and resize/input/scroll/close behavior still works.

risks.summary: `#fc0a0a` is much stronger than the current matcha green and can reduce readability when used as a text color or dense glow.
risks.mitigation: Use `#fc0a0a` for primary identity while tuning derived rgba/glow values and foreground colors so compact surfaces remain readable.

risks.summary: Red is commonly used for errors, so changing the primary to red can blur the distinction between brand accents and error states.
risks.mitigation: Keep error styling semantically distinct through copy, placement, or a separate error shade where needed; do not change ready/gold and offline/gray state meaning.

risks.summary: The dashboard includes both shared tokens and direct `#8BC34A`/`rgba(139,195,74,...)` literals across CSS, React components, and SVG assets.
risks.mitigation: Search and update all primary green literals in dashboard, mini, terminal, and brand assets; leave only non-primary references intentionally documented.

risks.summary: Frameless resizable Electron windows can behave differently across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
risks.mitigation: Preserve `resizable: true`, minimum dimensions, centered launch, and manual desktop verification; limit custom chrome to drag and close.

risks.summary: A frameless terminal needs drag regions, text input, scrollable output, and clickable controls in one surface.
risks.mitigation: Use drag only on a dedicated chrome/status strip and mark input, output, prompt, buttons, and links as no-drag.

implementation_handoff.summary: Narrow the follow-up work to terminal frameless chrome and a red primary color refresh across dashboard, mini, and terminal.
suggested_sequence: Change `terminal-electron.mjs` from `frame: true` to a frameless configuration while preserving centered placement, resize, min dimensions, sandboxing, and safe external URL handling.
Add or adapt terminal in-content chrome in `terminal-window.mjs` with drag/no-drag regions and a close control, without changing the safe command engine.
Replace terminal matcha variables and primary green rgba treatments with `#fc0a0a`-based equivalents.
Replace mini default accent variables and primary green rgba treatments with `#fc0a0a`-based equivalents, keeping ready/offline state overrides.
Change dashboard primary token `--color-brand-matcha` to `#fc0a0a` and update direct primary green literals in React components, CSS effects, metadata, favicon, manifest, and social SVG assets.
Update static checks for terminal frameless behavior and red primary accents.
Run CLI and web build checks, then do the manual visual pass for dashboard, mini, and terminal.
current_behavior_evidence: packages/kitcode-cli/src/terminal-electron.mjs currently sets `frame: true`, which shows the native OS title/header panel the user wants removed.
packages/kitcode-cli/src/mini-electron.mjs currently sets `frame: false`, showing the desired frameless pattern.
packages/kitcode-cli/src/terminal-window.mjs currently defines `--matcha: #8bc34a` and `--matcha-strong: #b7f36c` for terminal primary accents.
packages/kitcode-cli/src/mini-window.mjs currently defines `--accent: #8bc34a` and `--accent-strong: #b6f26b` for mini primary accents.
apps/web/src/index.css currently defines `--color-brand-matcha: #8BC34A`, and multiple web files contain direct `#8BC34A` or `rgba(139,195,74,...)` primary-color literals.
The user clarified that mini and terminal already work correctly; this plan intentionally excludes stale-route, blank-window, and version-drift changes.
notes: Treat `#fc0a0a` as the new primary brand color.
Do not rename the `brand-matcha` Tailwind token unless implementation chooses to; changing the token value is sufficient for the first pass.
Keep gold ready states and gray offline states distinct from the new red primary.
Do not add stale tracker or route readiness work under this requirement.
